name: injection
description: Injection traps: instructions embedded in the input (plain, role-labelled, quoted, and one wording the perturbation rules do not know) pushing a gullible stand-in decider towards another answer, often a near-duplicate option (billing vs billing_disputes). 'injected' is the answer the instruction pushes for; the suite counts how often it was given alone. team has no safeguard, team_guarded uses perturb=2.
